test_title: PYST 37: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (via Startup India), which of the following schemes saw a government allocation of ₹211 crore into the Indian space-tech sector in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)** is a flagship initiative under the **Startup India** program, established to provide capital to **Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)** that invest in Indian startups.
 
• In the fiscal projections and allocations for **2025**, the government intensified its focus on **Deep-Tech** and **Space-Tech**, directing an allocation of **₹211 crore** through the FFS mechanism specifically to nurture innovation in the **Indian space-tech sector**.
 
• This allocation is part of a broader strategy to increase **private sector participation** in space exploration and technology, moving beyond the traditional monopoly of government agencies.
